title: As The Clouds Part
gist: Teaser of a Louis-Vincent Gave piece arguing that the recent regime of binary market choices, which made capital deployment hard, is giving way as key developments are digested. It recaps secondary risks: Brazil and the LatAm bull market, El Niño and soft commodities, Middle East financial stability amid the war, and diesel/jet fuel shortages as inventories run dry.

insights.claim: Gavekal's recent research framed markets as presenting investors with a long list of binary outcomes across zones of deep uncertainty, which made deploying capital especially challenging.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: When outcomes are binary, sizing and optionality matter more than directional conviction.
